name: Odin den' iz zhizni babochki-odnodnevki
source:
Sefirot lives through eight lifetimes, carrying the full weight of her memories from one to the next.
Dayflies, born to live only a single day, leave their memories written on leaves, hoping the next will read and remember.

At the grave at her beloved, now gone after his eighth and final life, Sefirot meets a dayfly. She agrees to help her find the scattered leaves that hold the forgotten stories of her kind.
translation:
Sefirot经历了八世，承载​​着她从一世到下一世的全部记忆。
蜉蝣生来只活一天，它们把自己的记忆写在叶子上，希望下一个能读到并记住。

在她心爱的人的坟墓里，塞菲洛特遇到了一只蜉蝣，她已经结束了第八次也是最后一次生命。她同意帮助她找到散落的树叶，这些树叶中保存着她的同类被遗忘的故事。
